args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate (0.18).

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 (seq 3) was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was only a staging build.

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer.

5. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a normal error rate (0.002).
